trace.question: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
trace.evidence: Percent eligible for free meals = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Total (Enrollment (K-12)

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
trace.answer: The query returned 325 schools that meet both conditions. The first 20 include FAME Public Charter, Alameda Science and Technology Institute, Alameda High, Albany High, Berkeley High, Castro Valley High, American High, Washington High, Granada High, Livermore High, James Logan High, American Indian Public High, Oakland Charter High, Oakland Technical High, Amador High, Argonaut High, Inspire School of Arts and Sciences, Chico High, Pleasant Valley High, and Las Plumas High.
